summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Shabnam Elegant feature pack: admin TR/RU i18n with ERR_RU mapping, removal of AI translation endpoint, settings fields (map_location, instagram, telegram, facebook, tiktok), public contact map embed, social links in contact/footer/mobile-nav, removal of public admin link. 9/9 backend tests pass, all critical frontend testids are present and functional (login lang switch, sidebar lang switch, RU error localization 'Неверный e-mail или пароль', localStorage admin_lang persistence after reload, settings-*-input for all 5 new fields, contact-map-section/iframe/open-link with Toshkent location in src, social-contact/footer/mobile-nav-{k} for all 4 networks, 0 /admin links on public site, mobile 390px menu works with socials visible). Translate-missing endpoint returns 405 as expected. Settings restored to originals after test.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py SettingsIn.i18n is dict = {} (mutable default) — Pydantic v2 copies per-instance so OK, but prefer Field(default_factory=dict) for clarity.

put_settings overwrites entire settings doc with $set of all fields on every save; if a field is missing from a client it falls back to SettingsIn defaults (empty strings) rather than preserving existing value. Observed working because the AdminSettings form always re-sends all fields, but this coupling is fragile.

MapEmbed iframe uses Google maps embed with q=map_location string — if user enters an unsafe string with quotes it may break the URL; consider encodeURIComponent (verify in /app/frontend/src/components/site/MapEmbed.jsx).
